mentions.name: House Price Dashboard
mentions.description: A web app that shows house prices and housing costs across different areas in one dashboard, letting users gauge UK property prices in seconds instead of manually combing through Rightmove and Zoopla.
mentions.problem: Comparing housing costs in different areas required spending a lot of time manually searching through Rightmove and Zoopla.
mentions.audience: A house movers/property searchers; the author wished it existed when moving house
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been practicing with Claude Code and creating a webapp I wished exists every time I've moved house - https://housepricedashboard.co.uk

I've spent a lot of time combing through Rightmove and Zoopla getting an idea of housing costs in different areas, now I can do it in seconds.
